first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Register the nested iterator heap effect before replay
commits.body: Extend the original Commons Collections advanced history with one finite heap claim at the first parent hasNext call. The registration binds four endpoints, both caller-owned lists, the retained child and fixed-size sibling, normal queue unlinking, the removal receiver, and independent omission and stale-state controls. commits.body:

Follow the original next and remove into the actual backing iterator. The four-endpoint qualification, two live refusal controls per endpoint and offline admission checks are job 20261124-171715-check-the-nested-iterator-heap-effect-on.

A focused original repaired-JAR run matched all nine predicted writes and the registered next and remove sites. The Java tracers compiled, the job schema passed and the affected Rust tier passed after one automatic retry of a process timing test.

commits.body:
Register four original public histories before evaluation, including two resets with a caller-owned array and a second rewind after reaching EOF. An independent byte-sequence model specifies the return counts, byte slices and six helper tuples. Both original JARs compiled the observer and both manifests bind the tracked production files. The affected Rust and Python tests passed, 24 of 24 groups, and the job schema validated.

Job 20261124-172132-transfer-the-frozen-public-change-plan-t runs the frozen planner with the checked Math.min output. Job 20261124-172139-identify-the-original-commons-io-rewind records the first strict native attempt and the retry with charset initialization.

commits.summary: Qualify the iterator heap update on both PRs
commits.body:
Two original and two substituted JVM continuations per endpoint agreed on the complete entry-heap frame, next and removal receiver, and the registered public result. The retained child required nine changed fields, the flattened chain seven. All four deployments rejected a stale cursor, an omitted detached-node write, a missing original, a swapped receiver and a different deployment binding.

The collector job passed both steps in 22.5 seconds, using 18 CPU seconds. The committed receipt was independently rechecked against each cold public plan and the collector SHA-256. The affected test tier passed across 59 Rust binaries.

commits.summary: Bind the two stream positions and copy frame (verification pending)
commits.body:
Check the original bulk-read instructions from Math.min through ByteBuffer.get and the JDK arraycopy. Each observed checked length and every destination byte matched the independent byte-sequence model. Sixteen fresh JVMs separately crossed explicit and default encoders on UTF-8 and US-ASCII processes and exercised 32 sequential read/reset cycles each. The affected tier passed across 59 Rust binaries and the job schema validated.

Job 20261124-173333-prove-the-normal-reset-preserves-both-or repeats the profiles and checks a normal-exit induction over both original saved positions against the real reset bytecode and NIO methods. Job 20261124-173601-capture-the-original-commons-io-default records the precise pre-verifier charset refusal on both revisions, replacing the initial diagnostic recorder that expected JSON.

commits.summary: Close the Commons IO transfer and normal-reset proof
commits.body:
The frozen change plan established the second-rewind and preservation claims on both original JARs. All 54 checked copy lengths agreed with the independent destination oracle. Cold, warm and clean took 62.7, 22.2 and 63.7 seconds, with three of four registered sides reused. Sixteen fresh JVMs separated explicit UTF-8 from a genuinely default-dependent encoder. Z3 proved the fixed stream restores and retains both positions on every normally returning reset in the stated scope. The parent clears the marks and refutes the induction step.

The campaign now decides all 16 registered finite claims across eight PRs. The collector verified 48 outputs from 23 jobs. Twenty passed and the three failed initializer recorders have successful replacements. All 72 omission controls reopened, all 412 internal receipt references in 78 plans verified, and all 60 local report links resolved. The affected Rust and Python test groups and job schema passed.
